ns2:section.sectionText: This section is an online course. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. PREREQUISITES WILL BE ENFORCED. Students missing one or more prerequisites will be removed from the course. Any remaining seats will open to Business Minor students at approximately noon on Monday, April 27.
